prompts.knight: Use case: stylized-concept. Create one production animation atlas of the EXACT reference knight, preserving ivory gold charcoal red palette, equipment, proportions, detailed elegant pixel illustration style. Actual transparent background. Landscape 2:1 sheet. EXACTLY SIX COLUMNS and THREE ROWS of equal square cells, 18 complete poses. No text or grid. Each sprite entirely inside its own cell with 12% empty margin all sides. Same camera scale and fixed foot pivot (50%,88%) throughout, lower body stays stable except death. Row 1 SIX sequential attack frames: anticipation, windup, swing midpoint, impact, follow-through, settle to original idle. Row 2 SIX sequential hit frames: impact flinch, recoil midpoint, maximum recoil, rebound midpoint, settle, original idle. Row 3 SIX sequential death frames: stagger, buckle, falling midpoint, hit ground, settle on ground, final still remains. Specific character action: cast ivory orb toward RIGHT with orb hand, maintain round shield on other arm; death knees buckle then kneeling then collapsed. Every frame is a newly articulated intermediate pose, adjacent frames smoothly change limb angles. Same body size in all cells; fallen poses remain low and are NOT enlarged. No background, no shadows outside cells, no duplicated columns.
